patterns.exampleTransliteration: anā ṭālibun. ataʿallamu l-lughata l-ʿarabiyyata fī l-jāmiʿati. amshī ilā l-jāmiʿati thumma adrusu maʿa ṣadīqī.
patterns.exampleEnglish: I am a student. I learn the Arabic language at the university. I walk to the university, then I study with my friend.
patterns.grammarNote: A short reading passage — every word in it comes from an earlier level (طَالِب 54, أَتَعَلَّمُ 62, اللُّغَةَ الْعَرَبِيَّةَ 81, الْجَامِعَةِ 13, أَمْشِي 75, أَدْرُسُ 44, صَدِيقِي 82), except ثُمَّ ('then/after that'), this level's one new word — a simple sequencing connector for chaining actions in order. Try reading the whole passage aloud before checking the comprehension questions below.
